metadata.title: AI RMF Category Level — Example Profile

remarks.p: An example profile that selects the 19 AI RMF categories across all four functions while leaving their 72 subcategories out, producing a category-level view of the framework.

This example demonstrates with-child-controls="no", which is what makes the selection possible: the AI RMF catalog nests each subcategory control inside its category control, so selecting a category by identifier would otherwise carry its subcategories with it. It also demonstrates the flat merge strategy, which drops the group structure and presents the selected controls as a single list.
